newsitem.title: USA: Thrift stocks are thrifty to Friedman - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Thrift stocks are thrifty to Friedman - Barron's.

text.p: Values in the savings-and-loan and thrift stocks sector can still be found, despite the recent upheaval and the current consolidation trend, Friedman Billings Ramsey & Co principal Martin Friedman said in an interview with Barron's in its Monday edition.
Friedman told the weekly financial newspaper that profit margins at financial institutions do not narrow as drastically in rising-interest-rate environments as some believe.

If interest rates are raised again, a correction could be expected in the sector's shares. But the effect would aid share repurchases, which would in turn aid the earnings accretion to the shares, Friedman said in the interview.
Among Friedman's picks were ISB Financial Corp, Ocean Financial Corp, Primary Bank, WesterFed Financial Corp, PFF Bancorp Inc, Klamath First Bancorp Inc, and Greenpoint Financial Corp .
